title: Not every tsdb Service implements every backend handler interface
answers: Why doesn't grafanads have an admission_handler.go?
How are optional backend handlers (CallResource, CheckHealth, Admission) wired up?
Is it safe to assume a Service implements CallResourceHandler?
body: pkg/services/pluginsintegration/coreplugin/coreplugins.go's asBackendPlugin uses Go type assertions to wire up only the SDK interfaces a given Service actually satisfies (QueryDataHandler, CallResourceHandler, CheckHealthHandler, AdmissionHandler, etc). This is why grafanads has no admission_handler.go/conversion_handler.go while graphite and grafana-testdata-datasource do — it's per-plugin optional, not dead code to be added everywhere. Before assuming a handler method exists or is required, check the SDK interface and whether the specific package actually needs it.
applies: When checking whether a core datasource supports resource proxying, admission/conversion, or health checks — absence of e.g. admission_handler.go in a package is intentional, not a missing feature.
